title: Nuevo modelo open source: Qwen3.5-0.8B
dek: We find that frontier LLMs are surprisingly good at natively reading and writing neural network weights, using a variety of recent tools and algorithms or even via direct weight editing.
body:
## Ficha rápida

- Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B
- 0.9B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 0.9 GB (CPU / móvil)
- ~400 tok/s en RTX 4090, 4 bits
- licencia apache-2.0
- 833 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

We find that frontier LLMs are surprisingly good at natively reading and writing neural network weights, using a variety of recent tools and algorithms or even via direct weight editing.
